description.en: Registers an avatar (keshin/mascot-type participant) for the technique cutscene set up with CMND_INIT_SKILL_SCRIPT, by avatar ID.
Team side the avatar belongs to.
ID of the avatar to use.

Likely true once the avatar participant was registered; null if the call was invalid or the side/index don't resolve. The success value is produced by an internal setup helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Register an avatar participant for the technique cutscene
CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_AVATAR(_side, 1, _avatarID);
